_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.description: Parse the infra-health sensor map into typed targets and validate its integrity: every target names a sensor, a deadband and an actuator, or is an honest empty cell. The setpoint stays owned by the team's plan of record and is read, never authored here.
requirements.title: Typed setpoint read

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Read each named sensor live and join it against its deadband to report in-band or out-of-band per target. Every source degrades independently to an explicit UNAVAILABLE with a stated reason, never to a zero and never to a dropped row.
requirements.title: Live reading join

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Attach a closed-vocabulary trust verdict to every reading (valid, ghost, saturated, shelved, unit-mismatch, unavailable). An untrusted reading never contributes to an aggregate, and an uninstrumented target is never reported as healthy.
requirements.title: Trust-qualified readings

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Merge out-of-band readings, supervision gaps, untrusted readings and uninstrumented targets into a single ranked surface a member reads with one call, with each source named and independently degradable.
requirements.title: One ranked error surface

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Count and date the targets that have no working sensor, including this scenario's own blind spots, so an honest hole is visible and ageing rather than silent.
requirements.title: Open-loop self-report

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-005] tag) once the behavior exists.
